scope: Tuning and repeat verification on one PDF and the existing 41 questions (35 answerable, 6 unanswerable); no independent held-out test or answer-generation evaluation.
search_strategy: Coarse chunk/overlap/weight sweep; refine ranking on the two strongest chunk geometries; refine gates on five leading ranking configurations per geometry. This is not an exhaustive Cartesian search over all knobs.

selection.objective: Maximize precision@k subject to both floors, then recall and MRR; consider k=1,3,4,5,8,12.

verification.timing: Query embeddings and reranking recomputed without benchmark caches; passage vectors reused from fresh PDF sweep.
verification.metric_note: Precision@k uses k as its denominator and exact page/text labels; unlabeled but useful passages can count as irrelevant.

timing_scope: Grid runs cache query vectors, reranker pair scores, and some pure computations. Only the verified baseline/tuned reports and CLI retrieval report measure uncached query embedding and reranking.
